name: windows-host-operations
description: Windows host diagnosis and controlled repair across effective settings, startup and removal surfaces, and device stacks with rollback and functional proof.

interface.shortDescription: Diagnose and safely reconcile effective Windows state.
interface.longDescription: Diagnose Windows symptoms across policy, services, power, startup, packages, processes, devices, drivers, endpoints, queues, and vendor layers; bind exact targets, capture read-only baselines, prefer reversible changes, preserve rollback, and prove the user-visible effect instead of trusting a changed value alone.
capabilities: Effective-setting diagnosis across capability, configuration, policy, service, power, vendor, firmware, runtime, and observed-effect layers
Exact-target startup, persistence, application-removal, lock, and residue reconciliation
Device, driver, endpoint, queue, transport, role, and vendor-software diagnosis with functional verification
Read-only typed evidence capture with UNKNOWN coverage, before-and-after receipts, rollback state, and pending refresh, logoff, or reboot
defaultPrompt: Diagnose this Windows issue from a read-only baseline, identify the effective owner, and require functional proof.
